# Progress

A bar showing how far a task has got.

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- Uploads, imports and multi-step jobs where you know the percentage.

## When not to

- Unknown duration: use Spinner.
- Where the reader is in an article: use ReadingProgress.
- Steps the reader can go back to: use Stepper.

## Examples

### With a label and value

`label` names the bar for assistive technology (required). `showValue` repeats the percentage as text.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md"><Progress label="Subiendo inscripciones.csv" value={64} showValue /></div>
```

### Readable value

`valueText` replaces the percentage in what screen readers hear: "Paso 2 de 5".

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md"><Progress label="Inscripción" value={40} valueText="Paso 2 de 5" /></div>
```

### Tones

Tone changes the fill only; the text or the label says what it means.

```tsx
<div className="flex max-w-md flex-col gap-4">
  <Progress label="Cupos ocupados" value={30} />
  <Progress label="Pago confirmado" value={100} tone="success" />
  <Progress label="Cupos casi llenos" value={85} tone="warning" />
  <Progress label="Espacio agotado" value={100} tone="danger" />
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` (required) | `number` |  | From 0 to 100. Values outside the range are clamped. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Accessible name, and what the bar measures ("Subiendo inscripciones.csv"). Required: a bar without a name is just a number. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | What screen readers hear instead of the percentage, e.g. "Paso 2 de 5". |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Repeats the percentage as text beside the bar. |
| `tone` | `ProgressTone` | `'brand'` |  |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **`role="progressbar"`** with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`. `label` is required: a bar without a name is just a number.
- `valueText` gives screen readers a readable value such as "Paso 2 de 5".
- The fill is 3:1 against the track in every tone and both modes; the tone never carries the meaning alone.
- The fill animates smoothly and snaps under reduced motion.

## Content

- The label says what is progressing ("Subiendo inscripciones.csv"), not "Progreso".
